payload.title: [Figs. 6-8] Proximity Probability and Plume Distance
payload.description: This notebook presents a framework to evaluate the probability of observing a climate trace within an ensemble of trajectories, focusing on the proximity probability and plume distance metrics. It aims to assess the compatibility of climate reconstructions and model simulations. The notebook uses a new method involving the computation of q-norm distances and proximity probabilities, visualizing these metrics to define robust statistics of distance. The analysis includes comparisons between PMIP3 past1000 runs and LMRonline, and evaluates plume-to-plume distances.
